name: bayer_demosaic
pixel_format: unsigned 8/10-bit Bayer mosaic in, packed {R,G,B} 8/10-bit out
cfa_patterns: RGGB/BGGR/GRBG/GBRG via cfg_cfa; phase anchored at frame SOF plus cfg_ox/cfg_oy ROI-origin parity (all 16 combinations legal)
kernel: bilinear, truncating averages: G at R/B = (cross)>>2; missing chroma at R/B = (diag)>>2; G sites use (lf+rt)>>1 or (up+dn)>>1 by neighbor axis; site channel copied
boundary: REPLICATE-clamped 3x3 via stream_window_padded PAD_MODE=1; per-axis clamp, no zeros, identical in model and RTL
configuration: atomic cfg_valid/cfg_ready between frames; cfg_reserved!=0 rejected with cfg_error, active config preserved
throughput: window-engine cadence (row capture/replay), deterministic per size; demosaic stage adds 1 registered beat; outputs hold stable across m_tready stalls
remaining: static WIDTH/HEIGHT per elaboration; runtime resize needs a different window contract
edge handling is REPLICATE only; border-aware kernels out of scope
routed timing and board qualification pending
